name: Nasty Otter 73
author: KSAplay
description: Neon rounded pink play button that lifts and glows on hover.
howItWorks:
On hover, box-shadow becomes 0 0 0px 1px #F11271,
    0 0 10px 2px #FD3084,
    inset 0 0 0px 1px #F11271,
    inset 0 0 30px 2px #FD3084, text-shadow becomes 0 0 10px #FD3084, transform becomes translateY(-5px).
combined:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Nasty Otter 73</title>
<style>
/* Nasty Otter 73 by KSAplay — https://uiverse.io/KSAplay/nasty-otter-73 */
.btn {
  padding: 0.5em 2em 0.5em 2.5em;
  font-size: 1em;
  font-weight: bold;
  border-radius: 15px;
  color: #fff6fb;
  letter-spacing: 0.3em;
  text-shadow: -2px 2px 5px #FD3084;
  background-color: transparent;
  border: 2px solid #FEB1DE;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0px 1px #F11271,
    0 0 10px 2px #FD3084,
    inset 0 0 0px 1px #F11271,
    inset 0 0 10px 2px #FD3084;
  transition: 100ms;
}

.btn:hover {
  box-shadow: 0 0 0px 1px #F11271,
    0 0 10px 2px #FD3084,
    inset 0 0 0px 1px #F11271,
    inset 0 0 30px 2px #FD3084;
  text-shadow: 0 0 10px #FD3084;
  transform: translateY(-5px);
}

.btn:active {
  box-shadow: 0 0 0px 1px #F11271,
    0 0 25px 2px #FD3084,
    inset 0 0 0px 1px #F11271,
    inset 0 0 30px 2px #FD3084;
  transform: translateY(1px);
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<button class="btn">
  PLAY
</button>

</body>
</html>
